subject: planner: keep covering indexes for read-only tables in update join (#66845)
summary: This change prunes UPDATE-join output columns to keep all columns for updated table aliases while dropping read-only-table columns unless referenced by update expressions (via StmtCtx.ColRefFromUpdatePlan), enabling covering-index plans on read-only join inputs. It also filters handle-col mappings to updated aliases and rebuilds TblColPosInfos against the post-projection schema (buildUpdateTblColPosInfos), plus adds an early planner-side guard rejecting assignments to _tidb_rowid unless tidb_opt_write_row_id is enabled. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics/consistency/compatibility for the planner changes in this commit.
